title: Quality Engineer
description:

Project Role Description : Enables full stack solutions through multi-disciplinary team planning and ecosystem integration to accelerate delivery and drive quality across the application lifecycle. Performs continuous testing for security, API, and regression suite. Creates automation strategy, automated scripts and supports data and environment configuration. Participates in code reviews, monitors, and reports defects to support continuous improvement activities for the end-to-end testing process. 

 Must have skills : Java Full Stack Development

Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required

Role Summary
We are seeking a hands-on Engineering Manager who leads from the trenches - writing production-grade code daily while simultaneously driving team delivery and technical strategy. This is not a purely supervisory role. You will be an active contributor to Java Spring Boot backend services, React frontends, and API development, while managing a team of engineers and owning end-to-end delivery. The ideal candidate is a strong individual contributor who has grown into leadership without stepping away from the keyboard.

Key Responsibilities

Hands-On Technical Contribution
Independently design, develop, and ship full stack features using Java Spring Boot (backend) and React (frontend) with minimal direction.
Architect and build RESTful APIs and microservices from scratch, owning the full lifecycle from design through deployment.
Write complex Oracle SQL queries, manage schema design, performance tuning, and indexing strategies directly.
Personally contribute to CI/CD pipeline setup, containerization, and OpenShift deployment - not just review others' work.
Debug, optimize, and refactor production code to meet performance and scalability standards.
Actively use and champion AI development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) as a daily part of your own engineering workflow.

Technical Leadership
Set architectural direction and make independent technical decisions on system design, API contracts, and data modeling.
Conduct meaningful code reviews rooted in your own current coding experience, not just managerial instinct.
Define and enforce engineering standards, security practices, and documentation expectations across the team.
Evaluate and introduce new tools, frameworks, or patterns based on direct hands-on assessment.

Team Management & Delivery:
Lead a team of engineers through agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and delivery milestones while remaining a committed coder yourself.
Mentor and grow junior and mid-level engineers through pair programming, code walkthroughs, and real-time technical coaching.
Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions - and then build them yourself.
Manage delivery risk, technical debt, and cross-team dependencies without delegating your own engineering accountability.

Required Qualifications:
7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience.
Currently active and proficient in Java Full Stack Development - you write Spring Boot and React code regularly, not just in the past.
Deep expertise in RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and enterprise integration patterns.
Strong Oracle Database and SQL skills - query writing, performance tuning, indexing, and data modeling done independently.
Direct experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, and containerized deployments.
Comfortable working independently in ambiguous environments with minimal oversight.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent (15 years full-time education preferred).

Preferred Qualifications:
OpenShift or Kubernetes hands-on deployment experience.
Experience with API security (OAuth2, JWT) and cloud-native design patterns.
Prior experience as a senior individual contributor who transitioned into a working management role.

title: Python Fullstack Developer
description:
Role Focus: Full-stack Python engineering with strong practical use of AI coding tools to accelerate analysis, development, testing, documentation and delivery - while maintaining code quality, security and human review. 
 Roles and Responsibilities Be part of the Operational Excellence team, working on internal operations and client-facing technology projects. Design, build, debug and maintain production-ready full-stack applications and automation solutions. Work with internal teams and stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions. Demonstrate strong logical aptitude, independent research capability and structured problem-solving. Create and maintain clear technical documentation, solution designs, deployment notes and user documentation. Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to improve engineering speed, quality and consistency without compromising security, maintainability or validation. 
 Experience & Core Requirements At least 5+ years of hands-on software development / coding experience, with strong Python and full-stack development expertise. Proven experience owning applications from requirement analysis and solution design through development, testing, deployment and production support. Ability to review, validate and improve both human-written and AI-generated code before production use. 
 Backend Development (Python / Django) Design, develop and maintain scalable backend applications using Python, Django and Django REST Framework (DRF). Build secure, reliable and efficient RESTful APIs and integrations for web applications and automation workflows. Implement business logic, data models, database schemas, authentication, authorization and role-based access control. Optimize application performance, API response times and database queries. Write modular, reusable, testable and maintainable code following engineering best practices. 
 Frontend Development Develop responsive user interfaces using HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with practical experience in a modern framework such as React, Vue or Angular where applicable. Integrate frontend components with backend APIs and handle validation, error states and user workflows. Ensure cross-browser compatibility, accessibility considerations and mobile responsiveness. Improve UI/UX based on user feedback, business needs and design guidelines. 
 AI-Assisted Software Development - Critical Requirement Hands-on ability to use modern AI coding assistants / LLM-based development tools as part of day-to-day engineering work (for example, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent enterprise-approved tools). Use AI effectively for code generation, refactoring, debugging, root-cause analysis, test-case generation, API integration, SQL/query assistance, documentation and rapid prototyping. Write clear prompts and provide the right technical context so AI tools produce useful, maintainable and project-specific outputs. Critically review AI-generated code for correctness, architecture, performance, security, edge cases, licensing concerns and maintainability; never treat generated code as automatically production-ready. Use AI to accelerate delivery while retaining engineering ownership: understand the code, validate assumptions, run tests and be able to troubleshoot the solution without depending on AI. Apply secure AI usage practices: do not expose credentials, client confidential data, production data or restricted source code to unapproved AI services; follow organizational AI/data-governance policies. Identify repetitive development activities where AI or automation can reduce manual effort and improve developer productivity. Keep up with practical developments in AI-assisted software engineering and evaluate new tools based on measurable engineering value rather than tool familiarity alone. 
 Database Management Design and manage relational databases using PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server or SQLite as appropriate. Write optimized SQL queries and use Django ORM effectively. Perform database migrations, validation, data integrity checks and performance tuning. 
 DevOps & Deployment Deploy and support Django/Python applications on enterprise servers, VPS/cloud environments or approved internal infrastructure. Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing and deployment. Use source control (Git) and disciplined branching, pull-request and code-review practices. Monitor application health, logs, failures and performance, and support production troubleshooting. 
 Testing, Debugging & Code Quality Write unit tests, integration tests, API tests and appropriate end-to-end tests. Debug and resolve application issues efficiently using logs, traces, profiling and structured root-cause analysis. Use AI-generated tests or debugging suggestions as accelerators, while independently validating coverage, correctness and edge cases. Maintain code quality through reviews, static analysis, linting, dependency management and clear coding standards. 
 Security & Compliance Implement web-application security best practices, including protection against CSRF, XSS, SQL injection, insecure authentication and common OWASP risks. Handle sensitive and client data securely and comply with applicable organizational data-protection and information-security standards. Protect secrets, API keys and credentials using approved secret-management practices. Perform regular dependency/security reviews and remediate identified vulnerabilities. Ensure use of AI tools complies with company/client security, confidentiality, intellectual-property and data-handling requirements. 
 Collaboration & Documentation Collaborate with product/project managers, business stakeholders, designers, QA and infrastructure teams. Participate in code reviews, solution reviews and agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives. Document code, APIs, architecture, deployment procedures and key technical decisions. Explain technical solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Mentor team members and promote responsible, effective use of AI-assisted development practices. 
 People Skills and Other Personality Traits Self-motivated and continuously willing to learn new technologies, frameworks and AI-enabled development methods. High degree of creativity, curiosity and problem-solving ability. Good time, priority and task management with a strong delivery mindset. Ability to communicate effectively with internal teams, clients and cross-functional stakeholders. Comfortable taking ownership, challenging AI output when necessary and making sound engineering decisions. 
 Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills Experience building solutions that integrate with external APIs, enterprise applications or workflow automation platforms. Experience with Docker, cloud services, asynchronous/background processing, caching and observability tools. Exposure to LLM APIs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings/vector databases, AI agents or AI-enabled application features is an advantage. Experience establishing reusable prompts, coding standards or AI-assisted engineering workflows for development teams is an advantage. 
 What We Will Assess During Hiring Python/Django and API engineering depth, database knowledge and full-stack problem-solving. Ability to understand an existing codebase, debug issues and produce clean, production-quality changes. Practical AI-assisted coding capability: how the candidate uses AI to accelerate work, verifies generated output and handles security/privacy constraints. Ability to explain the reasoning, trade-offs and architecture behind code - including code initially suggested by an AI tool. End-to-end ownership, communication and ability to convert business requirements into working solutions. 
 Shifts: EMEA-hybrid (5 days working) Location: Mumbai/Pune/Chandigarh 
 Interested candidates can mail their resume to vivek.gopal@eclerx.com. 
 Thanks, Vivek Gopal Talent Acquisition Manager

 The Pre-Legal Sr Manager / Manager will be responsible for conducting detailed legal due diligence of land parcels to ensure clear and marketable title before acquisition. The role involves verification of property documents, coordination with internal teams and external advocates, and identifying legal risks associated with land transactions. 
 Key Roles & Responsibilities 
 Land Due Diligence Conduct end-to-end legal due diligence for land acquisition projects. Verify title flow for a minimum of 30 - 40 years (or as per company standards). Scrutinize sale deeds, partition deeds, settlement deeds, wills, POA, patta, chitta, EC, and other title documents. Identify encumbrances, litigations, acquisition notifications, and statutory violations. Legal Documentation & Verification Prepare title search notes, due diligence reports, and legal risk summaries. Coordinate with external legal counsels for title opinions and clarifications. Review and validate parent documents and link documents. Ensure compliance with local land laws, zoning regulations, and statutory requirements. Government & Statutory Checks Verify approvals related to DTCP/CMDA/Local Panchayat. Check land classification, conversion (if applicable), and master plan alignment. Coordinate for EC, guideline value, and revenue record verification. Internal Coordination Work closely with Land Acquisition, CRM, Finance, and Registration teams. Support registration process by validating documents prior to execution. Assist senior legal team during negotiations and closure stages. Risk Management Highlight legal risks, red flags, and mitigation measures. Maintain proper documentation and version control of legal records. Required Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of property laws and land documentation. Experience in real estate pre-legal due diligence. Ability to read and interpret complex legal documents. Good coordination and stakeholder management skills. Attention to detail and analytical thinking. Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and documentation tracking. Educational Qualification LLB (Mandatory) Enrollment with Bar Council is an added advantage.
